title: Agent Evaluation Question
description: A question for scripts/eval_agent.py, which drives the full scripts/app.py chat agent (LLM + MCP tools) end-to-end, unlike schemas/eval_question.schema.json which only checks retrieval.

category.description: Groups rows in the eval report; conventionally one of app.py's TOOL_GROUPS names (knowledge_base, search, reduction, plot) plus admin-adjacent lookups, but any label works.

expected_tools.description: MCP tool names (from mcpServer.py) the agent should call while answering. Order-independent; graded as a subset check (all of these must appear among the tools actually called).
